official.deadline_note: Subsanación (correction of application defects) runs 03/11/2026 to 24/11/2026; results 15/12/2026; acceptance 16/12/2026 to 21/12/2026; final list from 22/12/2026.
official.application_cycle: Convocatoria extraordinaria 2026 ('El Perú cuenta con tu talento'), 20 integral scholarships
official.status_note: The official page publishes the application window 30/10/2026 to 13/11/2026 (23:59) and states studies financed by the scholarship must start between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The official page lists 'Matrícula' as the first funded benefit; the bases clause 8.1 states benefits subsidise matrícula, pensión de estudios, degree/title obtention, thesis research, international transport, lodging, food, local mobility, medical insurance and administrative costs.
benefits: Pensión de estudios (study payments / mandatory academic fees)
Obtención del grado y/o título respectivo (degree and title costs)
Trabajo de investigación para la obtención del grado (thesis research costs)
Transporte internacional (international transport, only at the start and end of the programme)
Alojamiento, alimentación y movilidad local (lodging, food and local mobility)
Seguro médico (health, life, accident and repatriation cover)
Costos administrativos per the 'Normas para la Ejecución de Subvenciones para estudios en el extranjero' in force during the scholarship
eligibility: Professionals seeking a master's or doctorate abroad
No age limit to apply (no hay límite de edad para postular)
Programme of study must start between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2027
requirements: Meet the general and specific requirements for master's or doctoral study in the contest bases (RDE n. 149-2026)
Study only at institutions on the eligible higher-education institutions list (RJ n. 2953-2026)
Benefits are granted from 1 January 2027; no benefits are recognised for study time already completed
documents: Documentation listed in the general and specific requirements for master's or doctoral study in the bases (RDE n. 149-2026)
Sworn statement of the average gross monthly income of each household member (income test for 'insuficientes recursos')
Documents supporting additional scoring points published in the bases
selection_criteria: General and specific requirements for master's or doctoral study
Ponderación criteria in the bases designed to target high academic performance with insufficient resources
Additional scoring documents listed in the bases
coverage: Pensión académica covering all obligatory fees required by the destination institution (e.g. mandatory services, student fees, student services)
Grado y/o título respectivo - double qualification funding is not included
Trabajo de investigación para the thesis, in amounts approved by the Office of Administration and Finance
Transporte internacional only at the start and end of the academic programme
Alojamiento, alimentación and movilidad local from 15 days before classes start until 15 days after studies end, conditioned on the scholar's presence in the destination country
Seguro médico with health, life, accident and repatriation cover
Costos administrativos per the execution norms
application_method: Correct any defects during the subsanación phase 03/11/2026-24/11/2026
Accept the scholarship between 16/12/2026 and 21/12/2026 if selected
official.application_route: Online application through PRONABEC's official page ('Postula aquí'), following the requirements of bases RDE n. 149-2026.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Programme must appear on the eligible institutions list (RJ n. 2953-2026); prioritised and non-prioritised career/programme lists apply per EDO focus for master's and doctoral applicants
official.research_requirement: Doctoral applicants frame research for the degree; the thesis research work is a funded concept
official.duration: Master's or doctoral programme abroad starting between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2027; benefits granted from 1 January 2027
official.description: PRONABEC, Peru's National Scholarships and Educational Credit Programme, offers 20 integral scholarships for Peruvian professionals with high academic performance and insufficient resources to study a master's or doctorate abroad and turn their knowledge into development opportunities for Peru, with no age limit.

verification.notes: The official PRONABEC page and the full contest bases (RDE n. 149-2026) were read. No per-scholar amount in soles or any other currency is published on either: benefits are coverage categories executed per the 'Normas para la Ejecución de Subvenciones', and the only figure in the bases is the whole-programme budget of S/ 4,650,946 for up to 20 new scholarships, which is not an individual award, so funding_amount stays null. Deadline, phases, coverage and exclusions (no installation costs, no language levelling courses, no double qualification) verified against the bases.

applicant_utility.summary: With only 20 integral scholarships nationwide, this is a high-competition call where the application window is short (30 October to 13 November 2026) and everything hinges on the bases: eligible institution list, income test and the additional-scoring documents. Get your study programme started no earlier than the funded window - benefits run from 1 January 2027 and previous study time is never paid back. Because the scholarship pays categories rather than a fixed figure, keep the admission offer and fee schedule from a listed institution ready.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Peruvian degree-holding professionals who can prove both strong academic records and limited household income and want a funded master's or doctorate at a listed foreign university.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your target programme is on the eligible institutions list (RJ n. 2953-2026) and check the prioritised/non-prioritised programme lists for your degree level
Collect household income documents early for the sworn statement of average gross monthly income per member
Prepare the admission documentation for a programme starting between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2027
Collect the extra documents in the bases that carry additional scoring points before the window opens
Diary the subsanación window (03-24/11/2026) so a missing file can still be fixed
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a university or programme not on the eligible institutions list
Failing the income test for 'insuficientes recursos' - the household declaration must be exact
Applying for a programme that already started well before 1 January 2027
Missing the 23:59 cut-off on 13 November 2026 or ignoring the subsanación notices
Assuming installation costs, dependents' costs or language courses are funded - the bases explicitly exclude them
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Installation and personal expenses, dependants' costs, language levelling courses, double qualification fees and any application/admission fees at the destination institution - the bases state none of these are financed.
document_audit: The income sworn statement must cover every household member and match the amounts requested per month
Admission evidence must match the eligible university list exactly, not a similar-sounding campus
Any document in a language other than Spanish must be presented in the form the bases require
alerts: Results are published 15/12/2026 and acceptance closes 21/12/2026 - be reachable in mid-December
Benefits never cover study time already completed, so time your programme start
The call is extraordinary and limited to 20 scholarships - do not rely on a second round
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply online via 'Postula aquí' during the window, fix defects in the subsanación phase, then accept the scholarship in the December acceptance phase to appear on the final list from 22/12/2026.
